scenes.heading: Data Mart
scenes.subheading: A focused slice of the warehouse
scenes.narration: A data mart is a subset of a data warehouse tailored to the needs of a specific team or business area.

scenes.heading: What a data mart offers
bullets: Focused on one department or subject
Contains a relevant slice of the data
Simpler and faster for its users
Often derived from the central warehouse
scenes.narration: A data mart focuses on a single department or subject area, such as sales or finance. It contains only the slice of data relevant to that group, avoiding noise. This makes it simpler and faster for its intended users to explore. And it is usually derived from the central warehouse rather than built from scratch.

scenes.heading: Warehouse vs data mart
scenes.narration: A data warehouse spans the entire enterprise and covers every subject area, making it large and general. A data mart narrows down to one team or subject, offering a focused and specialized view. Teams often use a mart for speed and simplicity while the warehouse remains the broad source of truth.

scenes.text: A data mart is a focused, team-specific slice of the warehouse that makes analysis simpler and faster.
scenes.narration: In essence, a data mart delivers a focused, team-specific slice of the warehouse so that a group can analyze its own data quickly and simply.
